A suit and tie often symbolize professionalism, competence, and authority, so wearing them can trigger feelings of confidence and readiness.

It might also be about the ritual of dressing up—the act of putting on formalwear can serve as a mental cue that it's time to perform, lead, or take on a challenge. Plus, how others perceive and respond to you in formal attire can reinforce that sense of self-assurance.
